cohort: The study included 324 healthy periparturient bitches undergoing 406 elective cesarean sections at term.
finding: The mean hematocrit decreased by 6.4% points from 44.2% before to 37.8% after cesarean section and fluid therapy, indicating that bitches at term have hematocrits at the lower end of normal nonpregnant ranges without true anemia of pregnancy.
mod_finding: The study found a mean decrease of 6.4% in hematocrit in bitches after elective cesarean section and crystalloid fluid therapy.
followup_time: The last observation was taken 1 1/2-2 hours after induction of anesthesia for the cesarean section.
